# BaseFinder

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** BaseFinder

## What it does

AFK module to find bases/stashes with minimal effort

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/BaseFinder.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [Wurst — BaseFinder](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/java/net/wurstclient/hacks/BaseFinderHack.java)

Finds player bases by searching for man-made blocks. The blocks that it finds will be highlighted in the selected color. Good for finding faction bases.

Basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/resources/assets/wurst/translations/en_us.json).

### [RusherHack — BaseFinder](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/BaseFinder.html)

AFK module to find bases/stashes with minimal effort

Basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/BaseFinder.html).
